constants.decides: The whole-run ceiling the default quick preset fills into total_budget_seconds when the caller declares none, covering search, probe and validation (engines.py:2345, held in SEARCH_PRESETS["quick"]).
constants.measured_on: WP-1042 task-0 re-measure: six corpus quick runs (NIST SRM 660c, qarr corundum, zincite, zircon, fluorite, 11-BM NAC, GSAS-II FAP), macOS arm64
constants.evidence: Not answer-invariant: it decides which systems the shortlist can contain. Measured, the truth's own system completed inside it on every corpus run (115-126 s wall), four unrelated families, all high-symmetry; the stated failure is the trailing low-symmetry systems it cuts, reported by INDEX_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED. Rule 1's token clause is the case for it (a first answer in one call where the full run reaches 440 s); the case against is a low-symmetry cell the bound leaves off the list, as #1374's all-systems monoclinic rows return nothing at a 30-60 s ceiling (issue #1374).
constants.question: The corpus is high-symmetry; should the ceiling be re-measured on a low-symmetry family (bethanechol, #1374's synthetic monoclinic list) before it is kept, and is the SEARCH_PRESETS dict, which the audit walk cannot see, to be recorded on this row (engines.py:2345, :2391)?

constants.name: rietx.indexing.engines.VALIDATION_RESERVE_FRACTION
constants.decides: The share of a whole-run ceiling the search may not consume when whole-pattern validation will run, so the first answer arrives validated (engines.py:2385).
constants.measured_on: WP-2011 and WP-2063: 11-BM NAC, qarr zircon and corundum, GSAS-II FAP, NIST SRM 660c LaB6
constants.evidence: Already tier 3, approved 2026-10-28 (_audit.py:2439): 0.15 is the smallest measured share at which NAC's true cell validated, four unrelated families, and WP-2063 found 0.08-0.15 changed no system, candidate or ranking on the six sets. WP-1986's default run on bundled FAP (2026-10-22, Linux [dev], 130.7 s) validated none of its 12 candidates at the old 0.08, Le Bail and rank-order slices, before WP-2011 moved to Pawley, cheapest first and 0.15; WP-2011 then had FAP validate every checked cell at all three values on macOS.
constants.question: The WP-1986 run counted all 12 reported candidates, but only CONSENSUS_CHECK_TOP plus the promotable are ever validated; should the default FAP run be repeated on this tree on Linux to confirm its checked cells validate, and should a result say how many checked candidates the reserve left unvalidated (engines.py:2385)?

constants.name: rietx.indexing.engines.SEARCH_PRESET_INFO
constants.value: {'quick': SearchPresetInfo(title='Quick (default)', description=f'All registered engines, all requested systems in SYSTEM_ORDER, with a whole-run ceiling of {QU
constants.decides: The title, description, when-to-use text and measured typical seconds capabilities() quotes for each preset (engines.py:2419).
constants.evidence: Presentation: read only by capabilities.capabilities and the agent schema, held in bijection with SEARCH_PRESETS by a meta-test (tests/test_indexing_scheduler.py, tests/test_capabilities.py). Its numbers inform a chooser and move no search.

constants.name: rietx.indexing.engines.MEASURED_VALIDATION_SECONDS
constants.decides: The measured range of seconds per validation fit that estimate_ceiling reports beside its arithmetic (engines.py:2488).
constants.measured_on: the eight-dataset known-cell corpus (WP-1037), re-checked for Pawley on lab patterns and 11-BM NAC (WP-2011)
constants.evidence: Read only by estimate_ceiling, a pre-run estimate; it moves no search, rank or grade.

constants.name: rietx.indexing.engines.CEILING_GRANULARITY_SECONDS
constants.decides: How far past a declared ceiling a run can land, quoted by estimate_ceiling and the preset text (engines.py:2510).
